Maya (PM): Quick heads-up — ACME pilot asked for SSO in MVP. That would add backend + QA. Need a quick sync to decide tradeoffs and whether we nudge the beta date.
Ryan (Eng): @Maya rough ballpark — how much dev work are we talking?
Maya (PM): Backend auth + token mgmt + tenant mapping ~2 dev sprints (2 engs). QA + e2e ~1 sprint. If we add MFA it's another sprint. So 3-4 sprints total for a fully polished flow.
Samir (Design): We can trim nonessential flows (profile sync, account settings) to reduce scope. Keep just SSO onboarding + minimal account creation.
Lena (SRE): SRE note — SSO endpoints themselves are fine. We do need 1x additional NAT IP for outbound IDP calls and a KMS key rotation step. No obvious perf regression.
Ryan (Eng): So crude timeline impact: if serial, moves beta ~2 sprints. If we parallelize some QA/dev it's possible to keep within 1 sprint shift.
Maya (PM): Options to consider:
```
Option A: Ship SSO in MVP -> beta +2 sprints
Option B: Defer SSO to v1 -> beta stays on time
Option C: Feature-flagged pilot for ACME (targeted rollout) -> beta on time for majority, small pilot live
```
Samir (Design): Option C is workable but UX will be reduced for pilot users (no profile sync, limited settings). Is that acceptable to ACME?
Maya (PM): ACME wants SSO in the pilot; they'd accept a limited pilot if we scope it clearly.
Ryan (Eng): Option C is technically feasible: feature flag + tenant routing + canary. We'll need a short spike to validate tenant routing and KMS flow.
Lena (SRE): We can provision a canary pool on Dedicated for the pilot. I'll help with KMS rotation runbook and temporary IP allocation.
Maya (PM): Proposed immediate action: run a 3-day impact spike (engineering + SRE) this week. If spike <=3d -> go Option C. If >3d, default to Option B and add SSO to v1 cutlist.
Ryan (Eng): I'll take the spike. ETA Fri COB for results. @Samir can you do minimal mocks for the pilot screens?
Samir (Design): Yes — I can deliver 2 mocked screens + notes by Thu EOD.
deploy-bot: New canary env created: canary-acme-01 (provisioned).
Lena (SRE): I'll prepare the runbook and open the temporary IP/KMS ticket now.
Maya (PM): If spike shows big hidden intake (>3d), we'll revert to Option B and produce a reduced cutlist for the release. I'll update the launch calendar accordingly.
Ryan (Eng): FYI we can also parallelize QA (add one contractor) to recover ~1 sprint at extra cost. Worth discussing if ACME signs up for pilot cost share.
Maya (PM): Follow-ups assigned: Ryan - spike; Samir - mocks; Lena - KMS/IP runbook. Reconvene Mon 10:00am to decide. Thanks all. :calendar: :thumbsup:
Samir (Design): :+1:
Ryan (Eng): sg
thread_text: MVP SSO scope negotiation spike + pilot option discussion
